name: lal-uat-02-fill
description: Fills latest_active_lot on UAT after the 14-15 Nov load bypassed the sync trigger (1,177,828 CFS trades missing, every BU affected). Runs the deployed repair fn_latest_active_lot_reconcile(NULL, NULL, true) for every tenant and BU: it takes the exclusive scope lock per BU, writes only rows that differ and logs each scope to latest_active_lot_reconcile_log. Then ANALYZE. One transaction: BUs already done keep their lock until the commit, so deal saves, netting and valuation-date saves on UAT wait (or get the 'busy' message) until it ends; run when UAT users are idle. The step backs up the current cache (about 154 k rows), so the undo rule can put it back. Session: statement_timeout=0 and opera.lal_exclusive_wait_seconds=120 (see the command in analysis/latest-active-lot-uat-2026-11-19/README.md).

steps.sql: DO $$ BEGIN PERFORM * FROM opera.fn_latest_active_lot_reconcile(NULL, NULL, true, 'lal-uat-02-fill'); EXECUTE 'ANALYZE opera.latest_active_lot'; END $$

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.proname IN ('fn_latest_active_lot_reconcile', 'fn_lock_active_lot_scope')
preconditions.reason: the PR 177 repair and lock functions are deployed

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname = 'deal_active_lots_table' AND t.tgname = 'trg_sync_latest_active_lot' AND t.tgenabled IN ('O', 'A')
preconditions.reason: the sync trigger is enabled, so rows written after the fill keep the cache current
